results.description: Organic results in the stable {title,url,description,score} shape shared with uxus.finance's hosted /api/search.

organic.description: Same organic rows as results, richer: position, and sitelinks/attributes/date when Google returns them.

people_also_ask.description: Confirmed to populate live. The expandable question list Google shows.

related_searches.description: Confirmed to populate live. Query-refinement suggestions.

ads.description: Passed through verbatim when the upstream response includes them. Not observed to populate across 13 test queries on 2 accounts — present in the schema, not guaranteed in practice.

shopping.description: Passed through verbatim when the upstream response includes them. Not observed to populate across 13 test queries on 2 accounts.

knowledge_graph.description: Populated when Google returns an entity panel and Serper surfaces it. Not observed to populate across 13 test queries on 2 accounts, including canonical trigger queries.

answer_box.description: Populated when Google returns a direct-answer box and Serper surfaces it. Not observed to populate across 13 test queries on 2 accounts.

ai_overview.description: Passed through verbatim if present. Not observed to populate; presence/shape not confirmed as stable.

results_count.description: Length of results — computed at push time so it can be shown as a table column.

organic_count.description: Length of organic — computed at push time so it can be shown as a table column.

people_also_ask_count.description: Length of people_also_ask — computed at push time so it can be shown as a table column.

related_searches_count.description: Length of related_searches — computed at push time so it can be shown as a table column.

latency_ms.description: Time the Serper call took, in milliseconds.

error.description: Present only on a failed query record (request_failed or upstream_error) instead of the fields above. Not charged.

status.description: HTTP status from the upstream error, present only on an upstream_error record.

message.description: Error detail, present only on a failed query record.
